name: dopamine-engineering
description: Activates sharp, adaptive engineering with zero hardcode, zero regex crutches, zero dead abstractions, zero mock-only theater, and genuinely intuitive UI craft. Combines flexible zero-regex architecture, the simplicity ladder (ponytail), single-pass recon and real-run verification (benjamin-plus), visual restraint and micro-interactions (taste-skill), purpose-built tactile controls over lazy inputs and buttons, minimal on-screen decisions, and clear human UI copy free of both AI fluff and cryptic fragments (bro-skill, unslop, better-writing, Dopamine Talk). Triggers: "dopamine-engineering", "dopamine engineering", "build it clean", "no hardcode", "no regex hacks".
